label: French Rev.
description: Fall of the Bastille; collapse of the ancien régime. Khaldun anchors his cycle here; Strauss-Howe identifies the earlier saeculum crisis of 1773–1794.

label: Vienna
description: End of the Napoleonic Wars. Congress of Vienna resets the European order; Dalio would identify the beginning of Britain's long imperial peak.
European revolutions; Marx publishes the Manifesto. First Kondratiev trough by many counts; creedal-passion trough in Huntington's early-cycle framing.

label: Civil War
description: End of US Civil War. US state-breakdown climax for Khaldun-style readings; Strauss-Howe's 1860–1865 crisis saeculum.

label: Long Dep.
description: Start of the Long Depression. Classical Kondratiev-wave trough; Perez places this at the exhaustion of the steam-and-railways paradigm.

label: WWI
description: Outbreak of World War I. Global conflict-death spike; Dalio's pre-reset for the British empire; Strauss-Howe's third-turning collapse.

label: Crash
description: Wall Street crash, onset of Great Depression. Kondratiev trough in many countings; Strauss-Howe's fourth-turning crisis onset (1929–1946).

label: WWII end
description: End of WWII. Dalio's canonical US-empire peak; Kondratiev's post-war expansion begins; Strauss-Howe's high begins.
Global protest year; civil rights peak in the US. Huntington's creedal-passion peak; Strauss-Howe's 'awakening' phase.

label: Nixon shock
description: End of Bretton Woods; gold standard abandoned. Classical Kondratiev-peak marker; Dalio's mid-cycle debt buildup begins.

label: Berlin Wall
description: Fall of Berlin Wall; Soviet bloc collapse. Khaldun-style state-breakdown climax for a rival empire; Dalio marks end of the bipolar order.

label: Dot-com
description: Dot-com bubble peak. Perez's canonical installation-phase top; Strauss-Howe third-turning 'unraveling' climax.

label: GFC
description: Global Financial Crisis. Strauss-Howe's canonical fourth-turning onset; Dalio's late-cycle debt reset signal.

label: COVID
description: COVID-19 pandemic onset. Turchin's published crisis-peak year; elite-overproduction and political-instability signals converge.
